text: Your curls might be training only half your biceps.
Arm in front, on the pad. The long head goes slack, so the short head does the heavy lifting.
Arm behind your body. Now the long head is stretched, and it takes over.
Why? The long head crosses your shoulder. Move the arm, and you change its length.
One curl in front, one behind, and you've trained the whole biceps. Save this.
